title: Number of brothers and John's death in New York
summary: Five brothers and two sisters, their birth order, and John's death in New York around 1940-41.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Yeah, just good talent, sorry. Yeah. Um, can you tell some more now about your brothers, uh, since some of them are dead? How many brothers altogether did you have?
Bill, uh, we was five brothers and two sisters. Now, we're three of us living now. Since my brother Simon and John is dead, well that make me be the oldest one living. Oldest one.
How much older were they than you now? Was John, uh, or Simon oldest?

Well Simon was the oldest. John was next and I come right behind John. Then Eddie is behind me, also a good musician, was a good musician. I reckon you have heard him play baseball already. Yeah, I do. Yeah, he was really good too. He stopped playing. Oh, okay.

We were talking about your brothers. Um, Simon was the, uh... Oldest. Oldest. And then John. And then Lauren. Uh, how much older was John than you? Do you remember about? Well, uh, John was about three years older than me. Just about three years. Yeah. And, uh, when did he die? Was that in New York did he die? Well, yeah, he died in New York, Bill. I remember if he died if he died I got killed by now.
It was in New York when he passed.
Okay, was that in New York that he died?
Well yeah, he died in New York, Bill. I remember the day he died, if he died, I got killed by now. He was in New York when he passed. We didn't know until a day or so after.
Was that about 1940 or so? I knew he was up there.
Something like that, Bill, around 40 or 41, something like that, yeah.

Can you remember some of the bands he played in? About the only one we can always hear about is the Celestan Band, but do you remember anything about his life at all that he ever told you or that you can remember when you were a little baby, practically, he must have been playing when you were pretty young.
